title: Binder: canonicalize numeric member names (GetPropertyNameForPropertyNameNode)
description: Upstream names a numeric member by the scanner's canonical value (0b11 binds as '3', 1.0 as '1'; ast/utilities.go:3160 Text() = token value), so duplicate spellings merge into one symbol. This binder keys the source text, so they stay two symbols. Fix needs an owned string with the store's lifetime — thread an arena through FileInfo/bind_into (140 construction sites) or carry the canonical value on NumericLiteral via codegen. ~6 binder_symbols cases: duplicateIdentifierDifferentSpelling, numericClassMembers1, objectTypeWithDuplicateNumericProperty, dynamicNamesErrors, numericStringNamedPropertyEquivalence, duplicateObjectLiteralProperty_computedName1. Also unblocks the recorded signed-numeric gap in dynamic_name (binder.rs).
close_reason: Landed at 2c3de45: canonical numeric member names via arena-threaded bind API + jsnum in tsr-core; binder_symbols 8,411/8,473, checker_types +1.

title: Make TSR faster than tsgo on whole-project checks: public representative benchmark and startup/check hot paths
description: Lane perf. At 586c2ec0 the public smoke project (benches/projects/generic-imports) measures TSR 0.031s vs tsgo 0.024s median (observed_wall_ratio 1.32, /tmp perf-project, 5 samples, macOS arm64). The TypeScript src/compiler project fails tsgo preflight (types: node missing). Establish a committed, representative public benchmark project that both CLIs check with identical diagnostics, attribute TSR's wall time (startup, lib load/parse/bind, checking), and port faithful work boundaries so observed ratio <=0.50 while diagnostics match. Owned: crates/tsr, crates/tsr-execute, crates/tsr-compiler, crates/tsr-vfs, crates/tsr-tsoptions, xtask perf code, benches/, scripts/*perf*. Checker hot-path changes are reported to the integrator. Related: tsr-1yb.

title: constructor signatures: merged class+interface type parameters and defaults
description:
Regression exposed by the round-2 merge (PR #5, b3cd078d): compiler/reactDefaultPropsInferenceSuccess line 0:81 prints `typeof FieldFeedback` where native prints `FieldFeedback

`. React.Component is `class Component` merged with `interface Component

`. Native getLocalTypeParametersOfClassOrInterfaceOrTypeAlias gathers type parameters from every declaration, and getDefaultFromTypeParameter reads a default from any declaration, so `extends React.Component

` is inside the arity window. TSR's ConstructorDeclaration SignatureParts (signatures.rs ~5997) take only the class node's type parameters, and declared.rs local_type_parameters_of reads only the first declaration. Both inherited signatures therefore fail the window in resolve_class_construct_signatures (getDefaultConstructSignatures), `typeof FieldFeedback` gets a decided empty construct list, isConstructorType is false, and main's base_types.rs resolveBaseTypesOfClass answers error for FieldFeedback2.
